body.text: Forgive the paper. I had it brought up specially, and I did not want to use it on anything ordinary.
It is my pleasant duty to inform you formally that {param:gone}. I am told these things ought to be said plainly, so there it is, plainly.
What remains between you and the end of the matter is this: {param:standing}. Not a great deal, I grant you, but I thought you would rather hear it from a friend.
I shall of course write again the moment anything else gives way. You may rely on me absolutely.

tone.text: I have read your letter, and I answer it {choice}.

options.text: as a man who has not finished yet
with rather less composure than you enjoy
with the contempt your stationery deserves
knowing precisely how much you have enjoyed writing it

steps.prompt: What the Chancellor is to carry back

options.label: that the colony is not finished
options.text: You may tell the court that the colony stands, and that I intend it to go on standing.

options.label: nothing at all
options.text: You may tell the court nothing. It has heard quite enough from you.
